mapper.select: select ps.student_no, a.account_name AS student_name, ps.relationship from parent_student ps join student s on ps.student_no = s.student_no join account a on s.account_no = a.account_no where ps.parent_no = #{parentNo} order by ps.student_no asc

select ps.parent_no, a.account_name AS parent_name, ps.relationship from parent_student ps join parent p on ps.parent_no = p.parent_no join account a on p.account_no = a.account_no where ps.student_no = #{studentNo} order by ps.parent_no asc
select * from parent p join parent_student ps on p.parent_no = ps.parent_no where ps.student_no = #{studentNo}
select * from student s join parent_student ps on s.student_no = ps.student_no where s.account_no = #{accountNo}
